subject: Re: NorthBridge Bank | GenAI platform discovery — recap + mutual action plan + next steps
body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@northbridgebank.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 7, 2025 at 10:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: NorthBridge Bank | GenAI platform discovery — recap + mutual action plan + next steps

Sarah, Tom — thank you again for the time yesterday.

Per our discussion, here’s a quick recap + a strawman mutual action plan (attached) so we can keep the process moving on your timelines.

What we heard (please correct anything):
- Use case focus (initial): internal-facing GenAI assistant for operations + knowledge retrieval across policy/procedure docs; potential expansion to customer support later.
- Key requirements: private networking (VPC), no training on your data, strong auditability, and a clear story for how the platform behaves under load (latency/throughput predictability).
- Current pain: inconsistent p95 latency + ops overhead managing multiple serving stacks; also wanting clearer cost-per-request visibility.

Where Redwood seems to fit:
- Deployment: Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated (isolated capacity) depending on your data boundary and control plane preferences.
- Controls: audit logs, RBAC/SSO, encryption (incl. KMS), and configurable retention policies (details to cover in security review).
- Ops: console visibility into token-level cost + latency, and routing/fallback policies to keep apps online.

Proposed next steps / meetings:
1) Security & compliance review (60 min)
   - Goal: align on SOC2 scope/evidence process, audit logging, encryption/KMS, SSO/SAML, retention/data residency, incident response.
   - Proposed times (PT): Mon 5/12 1:00–2:00pm OR Tue 5/13 9:30–10:30am

2) Technical demo + architecture deep dive (75 min)
   - Goal: walk through Private (VPC) topology options, logging/export patterns, and performance levers (batching/caching) for your workload.
   - Proposed times (PT): Wed 5/14 11:00am–12:15pm OR Thu 5/15 2:00–3:15pm

3) If the above looks good, we can define a 2–3 week validation plan (lightweight pilot):
   - Benchmark target prompts/datasets (within your constraints)
   - Validate deployment topology + logging requirements
   - Success criteria: p95 latency target, throughput target, and security sign-off path

A few questions to help us prep:
- Who should join on your side for the security review? (Security/GRC, platform engineering, identity team?)
- Any hard requirements on data residency/region (e.g., US-only)?
- Do you have a preferred KMS (AWS KMS, HSM) we should assume?

Attachments:
- NorthBridge_x_Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v0.1.pdf
- Redwood_Private_Deployment_Reference_Architecture_1pager.pdf

Thanks — if you confirm which slots work, I’ll send calendar holds.

Avery Johnson
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@northbridgebank.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@northbridgebank.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 7, 2025 at 11:02 AM PT
Subject: Re: NorthBridge Bank | GenAI platform discovery — recap + mutual action plan + next steps

Avery — thanks for this. Recap looks right.

Let’s do:
- Security review: Mon 5/12 1:00–2:00pm PT works.
- Tech demo/deep dive: Wed 5/14 11:00–12:15pm PT works.

For security review, please include someone who can go deep on:
- Audit log fields + export (we have internal logging standards we need to map to)
- SSO/SAML (we’re Okta)
- Key management (AWS KMS initially; longer-term we may evaluate HSM)

On our side, adding Priya Nair (GRC) who will help coordinate evidence requests.

Data residency: US-only for this program.

Also, can you confirm whether you can share a SOC 2 Type II report under NDA? We can route via Priya once we have the request process.

Sarah Patel
Director, GenAI Platform
NorthBridge Bank

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@northbridgebank.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@northbridgebank.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 7, 2025 at 11:24 AM PT
Subject: Re: NorthBridge Bank | GenAI platform discovery — recap + mutual action plan + next steps

Perfect — thank you Sarah.

I’ll send calendar invites shortly for:
- Mon 5/12 1:00–2:00pm PT — Security & compliance review
- Wed 5/14 11:00–12:15pm PT — Technical demo + architecture deep dive

We’ll staff as follows:
- Dr. Aisha Rahman (CISO) — overall security posture + evidence process
- Markus Klein — Private (VPC) architecture + audit logs / export patterns
- Me + Stephanie Nguyen — process, pilot plan, and next steps

SOC 2 Type II: yes, we can share under NDA and follow our standard evidence pack workflow. Priya, if you send the preferred NDA flow (or confirm the existing one you have with Redwood), we’ll turn it around quickly.

Agenda preview for the 5/12 security review:
1) Deployment boundary + data flow (VPC topology assumptions)
2) SOC2 scope + evidence process (what we can share, under what terms)
3) Encryption in transit/at rest + KMS
4) Identity: SSO/SAML + RBAC + SCIM (if relevant)
5) Audit logging: fields, retention, export/forwarding
6) Incident response + support model

Also attaching a link for our sales-ready security FAQ (high-level). For the meeting we’ll go deeper and align on evidence requests.

Avery

Subject: Fwd: NorthBridge Bank | GenAI platform discovery — recap + mutual action plan + next steps

Jordan — looping you in for potential exec sponsorship.

NorthBridge Bank is moving quickly and is explicitly prioritizing VPC/private deployment + auditability. They’ve confirmed:
- Security review: Mon 5/12 1–2pm PT
- Tech deep dive: Wed 5/14 11–12:15pm PT

Assuming security review goes well, I’d like to propose an exec sync the following week (20–30 min) to confirm mutual commitment, success criteria, and a path through procurement. Would you be available to join as exec sponsor?

Why this matters:
- Regulated buyer with a clear platform mandate (could become a lighthouse account)
- Strong security posture requirements (SOC2 evidence, audit logs, Okta SSO, US-only)
- Timing: they want to make a platform decision in early June if validation hits p95 latency + audit requirements

If yes, we’ll prep a tight agenda and provide a one-page brief.

Stephanie
NA Sales Leader
Redwood Inference
